title: Kalyan minaret, Bukhara
summary: The Kalyan minaret in Bukhara, Uzbekistan, is a round brick tower about 45.6 metres tall and 9 metres wide at its base, tapering to 6 metres at the top. Inscriptions give 1127 as the start and 1129 as the completion, under the Qarakhanid ruler Arslan Khan. ICOMOS lists it among the city's outstanding surviving monuments.

uncertainty.note: The inscription gives 1127 for the start and 1129 for completion. End is the present.
